About the Team

Engineering Tomorrow's Waters

A Fresh Start With a Proud History

The HSRW Submarine Team is a student-run engineering group at Hochschule Rhein-Waal, building a human-powered submarine from the ground up. After a previous team built a working craft and the project paused for several years, a new generation of students is restarting the mission — carrying forward the original ambition with fresh energy, updated engineering, and a renewed drive to compete.

We bring together mechatronics, hydrodynamics, and hands-on fabrication — learning by building something that actually has to work underwater.

Discover the Team
Our Core Focus

What We're Building

Every part of the submarine is a chance to learn — from hull design to human-powered propulsion.

01

Human Powered

Driven entirely by pedal power. Designed for efficiency, endurance and control underwater.

02

Hull & Hydrodynamics

Shaping a low-drag hull that balances speed, stability and manufacturability.

03

Mechatronic Systems

Controls, sensors and drivetrain integration built and tested by the team.

Our Story

Then & Now

Then

The Original Build

A previous generation of HSRW students designed and built a working human-powered submarine — a serious engineering achievement that laid the foundation for everything we're doing now. After that team graduated, the project went quiet for several years.

Now

Restarting the Mission

A new team has come together to pick the project back up — rebuilding the group, refreshing the engineering, and preparing to get back in the water. We're starting from what came before and pushing it further.
